VISION & SITE 06 / 61

01 — THE IDEA
A landscapethat becamea building.
The clubhouse is conceived as a series of
soft, rounded volumes that echo the bunkers,
greens and water of the course it overlooks.
Bronze fins, travertine and timber wrap a continuous
glass edge, dissolving the line between the room
and the fairway beyond.

THE ARCHITECTURE 12 / 61

AERIAL VIEW · THE HEART OF THE PITCH
FROM ABOVE
At the heartof the pitch.
Seen from above, the clubhouse cascades down and merges with
the fairway — placing members in constant dialogue with the
building, the water and the course around them.
VM  STUDIO  GOLF CLUB CH. 02  THE ARCHITECTURE
·
·

AERIAL VIEW 13 / 61

02 — THE FORM
Curves thatfollow thefairway.
Rounded floor plates step down toward the
water, each one rotated to open a different
view of the course.
There is no front and no back — only a
continuous, glazed perimeter that the landscape
wraps entirely around.

THE LOCKERS
A locker room
for a full field.
Three hundred lockers accommodate
a full field of players — set in two
mirrored wings of 150, for men and
for women.
Each wing keeps its own showers and
bathrooms, and the flow of the plan
separates the wet zones from the dry
— entrance, bench and lockers first,
then on to the showers.
